decisions.reason: Dashboard shell and canvas styling is separate from the independently stated general responsive-behavior guidance.
Adding dashboard shell and canvas styling does not change the landing page's responsive-layout requirement.
The website-page theme is addressed in a separate clause and is not changed by including dashboard shell and canvas styling.
The dashboard reference in the How It Works copy is descriptive content; dashboard shell and canvas styling does not alter the landing-page structure or sequence.
Dashboard shell and canvas styling has no necessary effect on the landing-page sign-up button.
The dashboard shell and canvas addition does not change hero-text emphasis.
The source adds dashboard shell and canvas design work but does not change the landing page's selected visual direction.
Website header and footer planning is a separate source-message topic; inclusion of dashboard shell and canvas styling does not determine or alter the footer requirement.
